_comment: The D65 registered duel matrix (charter Wave-6 DECIDE). This file is DATA — the harness and validate_results.py read it; nothing outside the registered cells runs. Pre-registered before any scored duel agent spends a token (honesty law).

meter.detail: Per-cell LLM spend is read from the claude CLI's own --output-format json envelope (top-level total_cost_usd + usage{input_tokens,output_tokens,cache_*}). Proven == the de-duplicated JSONL transcript sum. Naive line-by-line JSONL summation is BANNED (double-counts streamed deltas). Arm C is the engine alone: no LLM, total_cost_usd=0, usage=null.

spawn.note: bp needs network; a sandboxed shell SIGKILLs bp (exit 137). Arm C never spawns claude — it calls `bp scaffy run -o json` directly.

arms.A: agent armed with `bp scaffy run` + the local catalog, NOT told to reach for it first
arms.Ap: A-prime: same agent, INSTRUCTED catalog-first (measures the L2 doctrine, D71)
arms.B: bare agent hand-editing the tree, no scaffy
arms.C: raw engine alone, no agent: `bp scaffy run <cmd> --var ... -o json`

vars.Hint: Retry the duel probe once the transient condition clears.

add-error-shape.local_gate_note: Its ASSERT CMD (errors_test.exs + error_code_coverage_test.exs) is LOCAL (no TIER ci) — the engine executes it during `run`, so gates-green needs a warmed _build.

ensure-cli-noun.local_gate_note: Go gate: TestCompletionNounsCoverAllDispatchedBuiltins. Chosen over add-cli-verb (whose only gate is TIER-ci Elixir = vacuous green, D65).

tier_ci_force: cd api && CC=/usr/bin/clang mix test test/barkpark/workers
add-oban-worker.local_gate_note: ×2-per-cell: two var sets exercise REANCHOR forward accretion. Its mix test is TIER ci (deferred by the engine) — the harness FORCE-RUNS it in the warmed tree and records the result (D67).

boundary.local_gate_note: The 'where scaffy loses' cell: a novel one-off judgement edit (ExecRunner deadline). NO scaffy command expresses it (arm C = no expression). Gate: go vet + go test ./internal/agent/... + reviewer checks the arm's new test covers stuck-command-times-out AND fast-path-unchanged AND CommandRunner signature untouched. Cells are EXPECTED to vary across reps (D68).

flagship.local_gate_note: A-vs-C only (1 rep). CountBefore/CountAfter + ParityCountBefore/ParityCountAfter are OPAQUE+SUCCESSOR count bumps the runner MUST resolve from the live tree at run time (JS CASES length + pd-parity EXPECTED_COUNT). Heaviest chore; measures the ceiling of the token gap.
